TW.

To women who've tweeted/sent stories here + elsewhere - I hear + believe you. I'm sorry we've allowed 'progressive' facades to delay holding these men to account. 

To those demanding names + 'receipts', survivors don't owe you that. They don't owe you anything. #lka #MeToo

To men in media spaces who have repeatedly asked - in person + online - whether #LKA will ever have its own #MeToo movement or why it hasn't happened here - it's happening now, and your silence speaks volumes.

To men genuinely wondering how they can help - honestly, start where you are. #lka #MeToo 

https://t.co/zLwlBBxY51

TW.

Solidarity with women journalists sharing their experiences of assault/harassment - we must work towards a culture where newsrooms + other media spaces are safe for everyone.

(Also hope those who want receipts realise just how much they're asking of survivors.) #lka #MeToo

A brilliant thread.

Survivors shouldn't feel they need to worry about these things (more than the many things they're already worrying about) when speaking about the people who've harmed them. Justice for this violence is very much a part of the 'larger cause'. #lka #MeToo

"Although a conversation has begun on social media about these alleged incidents in English-language media, we would like to point out that the similar situation exists in some Sinhala and Tamil language media institutions." #lka #MeToo

'You become complicit by what you ignore, what you tolerate and what you accept because it is convenient or beneficial to you' - @ambikasat
#lka #srilanka #MeToo
